directPaymentDiscovery.scope: Current official Stadtwerke Memmingen e-mobility page

adhoc.mechanism: Ladenetz app plus credit card without Stadtwerke Memmingen charging card

directPaymentDiscovery.note: The official page confirms that visitors without the operator card can charge using the Ladenetz app and a credit card, but the displayed numeric matrix is the MM Standard/card tariff. It is not promoted to ad-hoc without an explicit checkout/app price binding.

reason: Exact own-network MM Standard prices are official, and ad-hoc access is official, but the public page does not prove that the MM Standard numeric tariff is the price charged to a no-card visitor. Fail closed until a current Ladenetz checkout or station-level direct-payment tariff is captured.
nextEvidenceNeeded: Capture a current Ladenetz app/web checkout for at least one Stadtwerke Memmingen EVSE, or an official page explicitly binding the ad-hoc visitor flow to the MM Standard own-network prices.
